notes.title: Fixed 2.2 Online (trial version)
notes.content:
Fixed 2.2 Online (trial version)

*Important* Open Steam and it will appear as "Connected", you can check it by pressing Shift + Tab when starting the game.

Online mode:
- Finish the tutorial and go to the PC, on the "SEPE" page you will find the "Online" section.
- If you want to be the HOST, type the room name and password. Then click on "Host" (it will automatically save the game where you were) and wait a few seconds for the level to reopen.
- To join a Host you must enter the Name of the room and the password that the Host set when creating the room, then click on "Join" and wait a few seconds.

What can a guest do in Online mode?
- Collect items
- Prepare meals
- Deliver meals and confirm to guests that they have all their orders.
- Cleaning tasks
- Open packages
- Hitting npcs with a gypsy stick

Arrangements:
- Language switching
- Settings were opened when deleting letters in the server.
Note:
- Only the Host can talk to NPCs, so he is the only one who can take note of guests and talk to Er fluff, Er bola and Er Richal.

If you find any bugs, please let us know so we can improve it. We know this is the first online version, so there will be many bugs.

One bug detected is that apparently the client sometimes can't walk. We think it is because of the host internet. We are working on fixing it.

Best regards and enjoy.

notes.title: Fixed 2.0 Online (Trial version)

Fixed 2.0 Online (Trial version)


Online mode:
- Finish the tutorial and go to the PC, on the "SEPE" page you will find the "Online" section.
- If you want to be the HOST, type the room name and password. Then click on "Host" (it will automatically save the game where you were) and wait a few seconds for the level to reopen. 
- To join a Host you must enter the Name of the room and the password that the Host set when creating the room, then click on "Join" and wait a few seconds.

What can a guest do in the Online mode?
- Pick up items
- Make meals
- Deliver meals and confirm to the guests that they have all their orders.
- Cleaning tasks
- Open packages
- Beating npcs with a gypsy stick

Note:
- Only the Host can talk to the NPCs, so he is the only one who can take note of the customers and talk to Er fluff, Er bola and Er Richal.

If you find any bug, please let us know so we can improve it. We know this is the first version of online so there will be many bugs.
A hug and enjoy.
